chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hammad ibn 'Uthman, from Abu 'Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
When the man reaches fifty years, he should not sleep with anything of ghee (clarified butter) in his stomach.

key_terms.يَبِيتَنَّ: He should not spend the night/sleep

ai.seo_question: What did the Imam say about sleeping with ghee in the stomach after age fifty?
ai.summary: In al-Kafi, Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) advises that a man reaching fifty should not sleep with ghee (saman) remaining in his stomach, reflecting the Shia tradition of linking physical health with spiritual discipline. This specific dietary precaution highlights the importance of digestive rest and purity in preparation for night prayers and sleep, particularly as one enters middle age when bodily vitality begins to wane.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hammad Bin Usman, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘When the man reaches fifty years, so he should not go to sleep and inside him is something from the margarine’.
en.sarwar: 4. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Hammad ibn ‘Uthaman who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
When a man becomes fifty years old he must not go to sleep with an amount of ghee in his stomach.’”
